description: List members of a thread. Note that after and limit only apply when with_member is true, and Discord restricts this endpoint by the Server Members privileged intent. Returns thread members and next_after; page forward using after=next_after and stop when a page comes back empty. To fetch a single member, use discord_get_thread_member. No special bot permissions. Read-only; safe to retry.

after.description: User ID snowflake cursor to return thread members after; only functional when with_member is true

channel_id.description: ID of the thread whose members to list

limit.description: Maximum number of thread members to return (1-100, defaults to 100); only functional when with_member is true

with_member.description: Whether to include the full guild member object for each thread member (defaults to false)

name: discord_list_thread_members
